content:
**Ally: Spilling Blood** is an ally quest for Beckett in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Beckett has decided that, with him having possession of the Blood Eagles' Buffout Supply to prevent them from recruiting new members to their gang, it is time to go after the first of their triad of leaders. Go to Bloody Frank's in Berkeley Springs and kill The Blood, one of the leaders of the Blood Eagles. While there, the player character may also have to fight Jessi the Hook and Frank the Butcher, though The Blood is the only person that needs to be killed to complete the quest. Once this is done, return to Beckett for a reward.
